question: Where was the 44th Chess Olympiad held?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Chennai__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **44th Chess Olympiad** was an international team chess event organized by the **International Chess Federation (FIDE)**.
 
• The event took place in **Chennai, India, from 28 July to 10 August 2022**.
 
• It consisted of Open and Women's tournaments, as well as several events to promote chess.
 
• The Olympiad was initially supposed to take place in Khanty-Mansiysk, Russia, but it was later moved to Moscow.
 
• However, it was postponed due to the COVID-19 pandemic and then relocated to Chennai following Russia's invasion of Ukraine.
 
• This was the first Chess Olympiad to take place in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Uzbekistan** won the **gold medal in the Open event**.
 
• It was their second medal at the Chess Olympiad after having previously won a silver medal at the 1992.
 
• **Ukraine** claimed their second **gold in the Women's event**.
 
• They previously won the Women's event in 2006.
 
• English player **David Howell** had the **highest performance for an individual player in the Open event** with a performance rating of 2898 (he scored 7½ out of a possible 8 points).
 
• Polish player **Oliwia Kiołbasa** had the **highest individual performance in the Women's event** with a performance rating of 2565 (she scored 9½ of a possible 11 points).
